response.sql: WITH rating_stats AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), rating_mean AS (SELECT AVG(per_day_price) AS mean_per_day_price FROM rating_stats) SELECT AVG(rs.avg_length) AS avg_rating_length, AVG(rs.per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(rs.per_day_price - rm.mean_per_day_price) AS avg_excess_per_day_price FROM rating_stats AS rs CROSS JOIN rating_mean AS rm WHERE rs.per_day_price > rm.mean_per_day_price
